title: Polynomial-time bitwise exclusive OR
statement: Let $p$ and $q$ map bit strings to bits. If the functions $x\mapsto[p(x)]$ and $x\mapsto[q(x)]$ are polynomial-time computable, then the function $x\mapsto[p(x)\mathbin{\mathrm{xor}}q(x)]$ is polynomial-time computable.
hypotheses_covered: The one-bit output function $x\mapsto[p(x)]$ is polynomial-time computable.
The one-bit output function $x\mapsto[q(x)]$ is polynomial-time computable.
